name: 배틀 강화 BOX 「흑염의 지배자」
englishName: Ruler of the Black Flame Deck Build Box

description.text: The Scarlet & Violet Battle Enhancement Box Ruler of the Black Flame, released in Korean on 15 September 2023: ten packs of Ruler of the Black Flame, 170 cards of 46 kinds (Pokémon, Trainers, Special Energy and basic Energy), 64 Darkness Terastal Charizard card sleeves, a card box with four dividers and a VSTAR marker.

tell.text: An "SVF" mark at the bottom left, and a number out of 038
